equity.level_reason: The units are TB programs grouped by case count; no social-position dimension is defined, compared or discussed.

notes: Study design inferred as cross-sectional from a one-time program survey; the article names no design beyond a 'retrospective study design' limitation. High case-count programs are a subset of all programs, so the comparison is side by side with no computed contrast; CIs for mean priority scores are reported without a conclusion drawn from them.
view_issues: Table: Ethambutol unavailability 3/20 shown as 14.0% (should be 15.0%), and high case-count count (3/20) exceeds the all-programs count (2/50), which is impossible for a subset. Text cites interruptions 'in 2022' while the window is the 12 months before Jan–Mar 2023.
